args.title: Fix rejecting quoted column headers in statement uploads
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify parseStatement to use splitFields for parsing the header line as well as the data rows, so quoted column names are correctly split out instead of including quotes. This fixes the row shape mismatch error when headers have quoted column names.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseStatement function parses the header line by splitting on commas directly, without handling quoted fields. This causes the header to include quotes around column names, which makes the asserted row shape mismatch with the actual data rows when they have quotes properly handled. The fix is to parse the header line using the same splitFields function as the data rows, so quoted column names are handled correctly.
